title: Add unified cross-platform verification gate
description: Create Unix and PowerShell verification entrypoints for the pre-commit and release gates. Run formatting validation, go test ./..., go vet ./..., existing Unix and Windows smoke tests, and release QA including GoReleaser checks in release mode. Fail clearly when required release tools are missing; use temporary isolated fixtures and never mutate the repository or user installations. Document commit and release usage, required tools, expected runtime, and platform limitations. Acceptance: one documented reliable gate supports both platforms and distinguishes commit versus full release verification.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Inspected repository guidance and existing check/release-QA scripts. Implementing unified scripts/verify.sh and verify.ps1 with commit/release modes; release mode will use temporary GoReleaser output and existing isolated QA, while preserving check.sh/check.ps1 as commit aliases.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Implemented scripts/verify.sh and verify.ps1 with commit/release modes; check scripts remain commit aliases; CI and release workflow now use the unified gate; documented tools, runtime, isolation, and platform limits. Verified Bash and PowerShell commit gates, both full release gates with GoReleaser 2.17.0 in disposable temp directories, explicit missing-GoReleaser failures, and git diff --check.
